ambiguities.text: The specification states wallets 'MUST NOT assume that all calls will be sent in a single transaction' but does not define what guarantees wallets MUST provide when atomicRequired=false
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume when atomicRequired=false, wallet provides no atomicity guarantees at all. Calls may be sent in separate transactions, may be reordered by miners, and partial execution is acceptable.

ambiguities.text: The term 'unpredictable' for batch identifiers is not precisely defined in cryptographic terms
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'unpredictable' means cryptographically random or derived from unpredictable entropy sources. Implementation should use CSPRNG or similar.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when a wallet receives wallet_getCallsStatus for an ID from a different application than the one that created it
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume wallets should return error 5730 (Unknown bundle id) to prevent cross-application information leakage.

ambiguities.text: The 24-hour status retention period is described with 'SHOULD' without defining minimum acceptable retention
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 24 hours is the recommended minimum. Wallets may retain longer but implementations querying near the 24-hour boundary should handle unknown ID errors gracefully.

implicit_assumptions.description: Applications correctly report their identity when making requests
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious apps could impersonate trusted apps to bypass security checks or access batch status of other apps

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot predict or brute-force batch identifiers within the 24-hour retention window
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could query batch status for other users, leaking transaction information

implicit_assumptions.description: Blockchain confirms transactions within reasonable time so status eventually transitions from pending
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transactions stuck in pending forever would cause status queries to never return final state

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand the difference between atomic and non-atomic execution when approving requests
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users might approve non-atomic batches expecting atomicity, leading to partial execution and unexpected state

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet implementations correctly enforce call ordering as specified in the request
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Reordering calls could cause security issues in dependent operations (e.g., approve before transfer)
